sv.title: Lundapizzan får italienskt hedersmärke – av ambassaden
sv.summary: Skånes mest äkta napolitanska pizza serveras i Lund. I alla fall om man lyssnar på den italienska ambassaden. – Det var en överraskning, säger restaurangchefen Ioannis Kesidis.

en.title: Lund Pizzeria Receives Italian Honour – From the Embassy
en.summary: Skåne's most authentic Neapolitan pizza is served in Lund. At least according to the Italian embassy. – It was a surprise, says restaurant manager Ioannis Kesidis.
